76struct CommandInvocation {
77 QString command_name;
78 QStringList command_args;

80 QString command_string() {
81 if (command_name.size() > 0) {
82 if (command_name[0] != '[') return command_name;
83 int index = command_name.indexOf(']');
84 return command_name.mid(index + 1);
85 }
86 return "";

90 if (command_name.size() > 0) {
91 if (command_name[0] == '[') {
92 int index = command_name.indexOf(']');
93 return command_name.mid(1, index - 1);
94 }
95 else {
96 return "";
97 }
98 }
99 return "";
100 }
101};

103struct ParseState {
104 QString str;
105 int index = 0;
106
107 void skip_whitespace() {
108 while (index < str.size() && str[index].isSpace()) {
109 index++;
110 }
111 }
112
113 void skip_whitespace_and_commas() {
114
115 while (index < str.size() && (str[index].isSpace() || str[index] == ',')) {
116 index++;
117 }
118 }
119
120 std::optional<QString> next_arg() {
121 skip_whitespace();
122 QString arg;
123
124 if (str[index] == '\'') {
125 index++;
126 bool is_prev_char_backslash = false;
127
128 while (index < str.size()) {
129 auto ch = str[index];
130 if (is_prev_char_backslash) {
131 if (ch == '\'') {
132 arg.push_back('\'');
133 }
134 if (ch == '\\') {
135 arg.push_back('\\');
136 }
137 if (ch == ','){
138 arg.push_back(',');
139 }
140 is_prev_char_backslash = false;
141 }
142 else {
143 if (ch == '\\') {
144 is_prev_char_backslash = true;
145 index++;
146 continue;
147 }
148 if (ch == '\'') {
149 index++;
150 return arg;
151 }
152 else {
153 arg.push_back(ch);
154 }
155 }
156 index++;
157 }
158 }
159 else {
160 while ((str[index] != ')') && (str[index] != ',')) {
161 arg.push_back(str[index]);
162 index++;
163 }
164 if (!eof() && str[index] != ')') {
165 index++;
166 }
167 return arg;
168 }
169 return {};
170 }
171
172 bool is_valid_command_name_char(QChar c) {
173 return c.isLetterOrNumber() || c == '_' || c == '$' || c == '[' || c == ']';
174 }
175
176 std::optional<CommandInvocation> next_command() {
177 QString command_name;
178 QStringList command_args;
179 skip_whitespace();
180 if (index >= str.size()) return {};
181
182 while (index < str.size() && is_valid_command_name_char(str[index])) {
183 command_name.push_back(str[index]);
184 index++;
185 }
186
187 if (index == str.size() || (str[index] != '(')) {
188 if (command_name.size() > 0) return CommandInvocation{ command_name , {} };
189 return {};
190 }
191
192
193 index++; // skip the (
194 while (index < str.size() && str[index] != ')') {
195 std::optional<QString> maybe_arg = next_arg();
196 if (maybe_arg.has_value()) {
197 command_args.push_back(maybe_arg.value());
198 }
199 else {
200 break;
201 }
202 skip_whitespace_and_commas();
203 }
204 if (!eof() && str[index] == ')') {
205 index++;
206 }
207 return CommandInvocation{ command_name, command_args };
208
209 }
210
211 bool eof() {
212 return index >= str.size();
213 }
214
215 QChar cc() {
216 return str[index];
217 }
218
219 std::vector<CommandInvocation> parse_next_macro_command() {
220 std::vector<CommandInvocation> res;
221
222 while (auto cmd = next_command()) {
223 res.push_back(cmd.value());
224 skip_whitespace();
225 if (eof()) break;
226 if (cc() == ';') {
227 index++;
228 }
229 }
230
231 return res;
232 }
233

385 std::unique_ptr<Command> get_subcommand(CommandInvocation invocation) {

711 void perform_subcommand(int index) {
712 if (!performed[index]) {
713 if (commands[index]->pushes_state()) {
714 widget->push_state();
715 }
716
717 // addresses https://github.com/ahrm/sioyek/issues/1114#issuecomment-2465490589
718 // e.g. when defining a custom command like goto_beginning;fit_to_page_smart we want to pass the num_repeats to goto_beginning
719 // of course since there are multiple commands it is ambiguous which command actually gets the num_repeats, here we just pass
720 // it to the first command
721 if (index == 0 && (num_repeats > 0)) {
722 commands[index]->set_num_repeats(num_repeats);
723 }
724 else {
725 commands[index]->set_num_repeats(0);
726 }
727
728 commands[index]->run();
729 performed[index] = true;
730 }
731 }

809 int get_current_mode_index() {
810 if (is_modal) {
811 std::string mode_str = widget->get_current_mode_string();
812 for (int i = 0; i < commands.size(); i++) {
813 if (mode_matches(mode_str, modes[i])) {
814 return i;
815 }
816 }
817 return -1;
818
819 }
820
821 return -1;
822 }
823
824 int get_current_executing_command_index() {
825 if (is_modal) {
826 return get_current_mode_index();
827 }
828 else {
829 for (int i = 0; i < performed.size(); i++) {
830 if (!performed[i]) return i;
831 }
832 }
833 return -1;
834 }
835
836
837 void on_text_change(const QString& new_text) override {
838 if (is_modal) {
839 int mode_index = get_current_mode_index();
840 if (mode_index != -1) {
841 commands[mode_index]->on_text_change(new_text);
842 }
843 }
844 else {
845 if (commands.size() == 1) {
846 commands[0]->on_text_change(new_text);
847 }
848 }
849 }
850
851 std::vector<char> special_symbols() override {
852 int command_index = get_current_executing_command_index();
853 if (command_index != -1) {
854 return commands[command_index]->special_symbols();
855 }
856 return {};
857 }
858
859 bool mode_matches(std::string current_mode, std::string command_mode) {
860 for (auto c : command_mode) {
861 if (current_mode.find(c) == std::string::npos) {
862 return false;
863 }
864 }
865 return true;
866 }
867
868 std::string get_name() override {
869 if (name.size() > 0 || commands.size() == 0) {
870 return name;
871 }
872 else {
873 if (is_modal) {
874 int mode_index = get_current_mode_index();
875 if (mode_index != -1) {
876 return commands[mode_index]->get_name();
877 }
878 return "";
879 }
880 else {
881
882 std::string res;
883 for (auto& command : commands) {
884 res += command->get_name();
885 }
886 return res;
887 }
888 //return "[macro]" + commands[0]->get_name();
889 }
890 }
891
892 virtual void on_cancel() override{
893 int current_index = get_current_executing_command_index();
894 if (current_index != -1) {
895 commands[current_index]->on_cancel();
896 }
897
898 for (auto& command : commands) {
899 if (command->is_done) {
900 *command->is_done = true;
901 }
902 }
903 }
904
905 std::string get_pending_name() override {
906
907 if (name.size() > 0 || commands.size() == 0) {
908 return name;
909 }
910 else {
911 if (is_modal){
912 int mode_index = get_current_mode_index();
913 if (mode_index != -1) {
914 return commands[mode_index]->get_name();
915 }
916 return "";
917 }
918 else {
919 for (int i = 0; i < commands.size(); i++) {
920 if (commands[i]->next_requirement(widget)) {
921 return commands[i]->get_pending_name();
922 }
923 }
924 return "";
925 }
926 }
927 }
928
929 std::string get_human_readable_name() override{
930 if (name.size() > 0 || commands.size() == 0) {
931 return name;
932 }
933 else {
934 if (is_modal) {
935 int mode_index = get_current_mode_index();
936 if (mode_index != -1) {
937 return commands[mode_index]->get_human_readable_name();
938 }
939 return "";
940 }
941 else {
942
943 std::string res;
944 for (auto& command : commands) {
945 res += command->get_human_readable_name();
946 }
947 return res;
948 }
949 //return "[macro]" + commands[0]->get_name();
950 }
951 }
952
953};

1009AbsoluteRect get_rect_from_string(std::wstring str, DocumentView* dv) {
1010 bool is_window = false;
1011 if (str.size() > 0 && str[0] == 'W') {
1012 is_window = true;
1013 str = str.substr(2);
1014 }
1015
1016 QStringList parts = QString::fromStdWString(str).split(' ');
1017
1018 if (!is_window) {
1019 AbsoluteRect result;
1020 result.x0 = parts[0].toFloat();
1021 result.y0 = parts[1].toFloat();
1022 result.x1 = parts[2].toFloat();
1023 result.y1 = parts[3].toFloat();
1024 return result;
1025 }
1026 else {
1027 NormalizedWindowRect nwr;
1028 nwr.x0 = parts[0].toFloat();
1029 nwr.y1 = parts[1].toFloat();
1030 nwr.x1 = parts[2].toFloat();
1031 nwr.y0 = parts[3].toFloat();
1032 WindowRect wr = dv->normalized_to_window_rect(nwr);
1033 auto top_left = dv->window_to_absolute_document_pos(wr.top_left());
1034 auto bottom_right = dv->window_to_absolute_document_pos(wr.bottom_right());
1035 return AbsoluteRect(top_left, bottom_right);
1036 }
1037
1038}
1039
1040AbsoluteDocumentPos get_point_from_string(std::wstring str) {
1041 QStringList parts = QString::fromStdWString(str).split(' ');
1042
1043 AbsoluteDocumentPos result;
1044 result.x = parts[0].toFloat();
1045 result.y = parts[1].toFloat();
1046 return result;
1047}
1048
1049void Command::set_next_requirement_with_string(std::wstring str) {
1050 std::optional<Requirement> maybe_req = next_requirement(widget);
1051 if (maybe_req) {
1052 Requirement req = maybe_req.value();
1053 if (req.type == RequirementType::Text || req.type == RequirementType::Password) {
1054 set_text_requirement(str);
1055 }
1056 else if (req.type == RequirementType::Symbol) {
1057 set_symbol_requirement(str[0]);
1058 }
1059 else if (req.type == RequirementType::File || req.type == RequirementType::Folder) {
1060 set_file_requirement(str);
1061 }
1062 else if (req.type == RequirementType::Rect) {
1063 set_rect_requirement(get_rect_from_string(str, widget->main_document_view));
1064 }
1065 else if (req.type == RequirementType::Point) {
1066 set_point_requirement(get_point_from_string(str));
1067 }
1068 else if (req.type == RequirementType::Generic) {
1069 set_generic_requirement(QString::fromStdWString(str));
1070 }
1071 }
1072}

1122class GenericPathAndLocationCommand : public Command {
1123public:
1124
1125 std::optional<QVariant> target_location;
1126 bool is_hash = false;
1127 GenericPathAndLocationCommand(std::string name, MainWidget* w, bool is_hash_ = false) : Command(name, w) { is_hash = is_hash_; };
1128
1129 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
1130 if (target_location) {
1131 return {};
1132 }
1133 else {
1134 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Generic, "Location" };
1135 }
1136 }
1137
1138 void set_generic_requirement(QVariant value) {
1139 target_location = value;
1140 }
1141
1142 void perform() {
1143 QList<QVariant> values = target_location.value().toList();
1144 std::wstring file_name = values[0].toString().toStdWString();
1145
1146 if (values.size() == 1) {
1147 if (is_hash) {
1148 widget->open_document_with_hash(utf8_encode(file_name));
1149 widget->validate_render();
1150 }
1151 else {
1152 widget->open_document(file_name);
1153 widget->validate_render();
1154 }
1155 }
1156 else if (values.size() == 2) {
1157 float y_offset = values[1].toFloat();
1158 widget->open_document(file_name, 0.0f, y_offset);
1159 widget->validate_render();
1160 }
1161 else {
1162 float x_offset = values[1].toFloat();
1163 float y_offset = values[2].toFloat();
1164
1165 widget->open_document(file_name, x_offset, y_offset);
1166 widget->validate_render();
1167 }
1168 }
1169
1170 bool pushes_state() {
1171 return true;
1172 }
1173};

1727 //widget->config_manager->get_config

2164
2165 AddBookmarkMarkedCommand(MainWidget* w) : Command(cname, w) {};
2166
2167 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) override {
2168
2169 if (!point_.has_value()) {
2170 Requirement req = { RequirementType::Point, "Bookmark Location" };
2171 return req;

2186 point_ = value;
2187

2189
2190 incomplete_bookmark.begin_x = value.x;
2191 incomplete_bookmark.begin_y = value.y;
2192
2193 pending_index = widget->doc()->add_incomplete_bookmark(incomplete_bookmark);
2194 widget->set_selected_bookmark_index(pending_index);
2195 widget->invalidate_render();
2196 }

2199 if (pending_index != -1) {
2200 widget->doc()->undo_pending_bookmark(pending_index);
2201 }
2202 Command::on_cancel();
2203 }
2204
2205 void perform() override {
2206 if (text_->size() > 0) {
2207 std::string uuid = widget->doc()->add_pending_bookmark(pending_index, text_.value());
2208 widget->invalidate_render();
2209 result = utf8_decode(uuid);
2210 widget->set_selected_bookmark_index(-1);

2213 widget->doc()->undo_pending_bookmark(pending_index);
2214 }

2330 window_rect.y0 += 1;

2348
2349public:
2350 static inline const std::string cname = "copy_screenshot_to_scratchpad";
2351 static inline const std::string hname = "Copy window screenshot to scratchpad";
2352
2353 std::optional<AbsoluteRect> rect_;
2354
2355 CopyScreenshotToScratchpad(MainWidget* w) : Command(cname, w) {};
2356
2357 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
2358
2359 if (!rect_.has_value()) {
2360 Requirement req = { RequirementType::Rect, "Screenshot rect" };
2361 return req;
2362 }
2363 return {};
2364 }
2365
2366 void set_rect_requirement(AbsoluteRect value) {
2367 rect_ = value;
2368 }
2369
2370 void perform() {
2371 widget->clear_selected_rect();
2372
2373 WindowRect window_rect = rect_->to_window(widget->main_document_view);
2374 window_rect.y0 += 1;
2375 QRect window_qrect = QRect(window_rect.x0, window_rect.y0, window_rect.width(), window_rect.height());
2376
2377 float ratio = QGuiApplication::primaryScreen()->devicePixelRatio();
2378 QPixmap pixmap(static_cast<int>(window_qrect.width() * ratio), static_cast<int>(window_qrect.height() * ratio));
2379 pixmap.setDevicePixelRatio(ratio);
2380
2381 //widget->render(&pixmap, QPoint(), QRegion(widget->rect()));
2382 widget->render(&pixmap, QPoint(), QRegion(window_qrect));
2383 widget->toggle_scratchpad_mode();
2384 widget->add_pixmap_to_scratchpad(pixmap);
2385 widget->set_rect_select_mode(false);
2386 widget->invalidate_render();
2387 }

2390class AddBookmarkFreetextCommand : public Command {
2391
2392public:
2393 static inline const std::string cname = "add_freetext_bookmark";
2394 static inline const std::string hname = "Add a text bookmark in the selected rectangle";
2395
2396 std::optional<std::wstring> text_;
2397 std::optional<AbsoluteRect> rect_;
2398 int pending_index = -1;
2399
2400 AddBookmarkFreetextCommand(MainWidget* w) : Command(cname, w) {};
2401
2402 void on_text_change(const QString& new_text) override {
2403 widget->doc()->get_bookmarks()[widget->selected_bookmark_index].description = new_text.toStdWString();
2404 }
2405
2406 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) override {
2407
2408 if (!rect_.has_value()) {
2409 Requirement req = { RequirementType::Rect, "Bookmark Location" };
2410 return req;
2411 }
2412 if (!text_.has_value()) {
2413 Requirement req = { RequirementType::Text, "Bookmark Text" };
2414 return req;
2415 }
2416 return {};
2417 }
2418
2419 void set_text_requirement(std::wstring value) override {
2420 text_ = value;
2421 }
2422
2423 void set_rect_requirement(AbsoluteRect value) override {
2424 rect_ = value;
2425 BookMark incomplete_bookmark;
2426
2427 incomplete_bookmark.begin_x = std::min<float>(value.x0, value.x1);
2428 incomplete_bookmark.end_x = std::max<float>(value.x0, value.x1);
2429 incomplete_bookmark.begin_y = std::min<float>(value.y0, value.y1);
2430 incomplete_bookmark.end_y = std::max<float>(value.y0, value.y1);
2431
2432 incomplete_bookmark.color[0] = FREETEXT_BOOKMARK_COLOR[0];
2433 incomplete_bookmark.color[1] = FREETEXT_BOOKMARK_COLOR[1];
2434 incomplete_bookmark.color[2] = FREETEXT_BOOKMARK_COLOR[2];
2435
2436 pending_index = widget->doc()->add_incomplete_bookmark(incomplete_bookmark);
2437 widget->set_selected_bookmark_index(pending_index);
2438
2439 widget->clear_selected_rect();
2440 widget->validate_render();
2441 }
2442
2443
2444 void on_cancel() override {
2445
2446 if (pending_index != -1) {
2447 widget->doc()->undo_pending_bookmark(pending_index);
2448 }
2449 Command::on_cancel();
2450 }
2451
2452 void perform() override {
2453 //widget->doc()->add_freetext_bookmark(text_.value(), rect_.value());
2454 if (text_.value().size() > 0) {
2455 std::string uuid = widget->doc()->add_pending_bookmark(pending_index, text_.value());
2456 result = utf8_decode(uuid);
2457 widget->set_selected_bookmark_index(-1);
2458 }
2459 else {
2460 widget->doc()->undo_pending_bookmark(pending_index);
2461 result = L"";
2462 }
2463
2464 widget->clear_selected_rect();
2465 widget->invalidate_render();
2466 }
2467};

2573class GotoTableOfContentsCommand : public GenericPathCommand {
2574public:
2575 static inline const std::string cname = "goto_toc";
2576 static inline const std::string hname = "Open table of contents";
2577 GotoTableOfContentsCommand(MainWidget* w) : GenericPathCommand(cname, w) {};
2578
2579 std::optional<QVariant> target_location = {};
2580
2581 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
2582 if (target_location) {
2583 return {};
2584 }
2585 else {
2586 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Generic, "Location" };
2587 }
2588 }
2589
2590 void set_generic_requirement(QVariant value) {
2591 target_location = value;
2592 }
2593
2594
2595 void handle_generic_requirement() {
2596 //widget->handle_goto_loaded_document();
2597 widget->handle_goto_toc();
2598 }
2599
2600
2601 void perform() {
2602 QVariant val = target_location.value();
2603
2604 if (val.canConvert<int>()) {
2605 int page = val.toInt();
2606
2607 widget->main_document_view->goto_page(page);
2608
2609 if (TOC_JUMP_ALIGN_TOP) {
2610 widget->main_document_view->scroll_mid_to_top();
2611 }
2612 }
2613 else {
2614 QList<QVariant> location = val.toList();
2615 int page = location[0].toInt();
2616 float x_offset = location[1].toFloat();
2617 float y_offset = location[2].toFloat();
2618
2619 if (std::isnan(y_offset)) {
2620 widget->main_document_view->goto_page(page);
2621 }
2622 else {
2623 widget->main_document_view->goto_offset_within_page(page, y_offset);
2624 }
2625 if (TOC_JUMP_ALIGN_TOP) {
2626 widget->main_document_view->scroll_mid_to_top();
2627 }
2628
2629 }
2630 }
2631
2632 bool pushes_state() { return true; }
2633};

2900class GenericWaitCommand : public Command {
2901public:
2902 GenericWaitCommand(std::string name, MainWidget* w) : Command(name, w) {};
2903 bool finished = false;
2904 QTimer* timer = nullptr;
2905 QMetaObject::Connection timer_connection;
2906
2907 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) override {
2908 if (!finished) {
2909 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Generic, "dummy" };
2910 }
2911 else {
2912 return {};
2913 }
2914 }
2915
2916 virtual ~GenericWaitCommand() {
2917
2918 if (timer) {
2919 timer->stop();
2920 timer->deleteLater();
2921 }
2922 }
2923
2924 void set_generic_requirement(QVariant value) override
2925 {
2926 finished = true;
2927 }
2928
2929 bool is_ready() override = 0;
2930
2931 void handle_generic_requirement() override{
2932 if (finished) return;
2933
2934 timer = new QTimer();
2935 timer->setInterval(100);
2936 timer_connection = QObject::connect(timer, &QTimer::timeout, [this]() {
2937 if (is_ready()) {
2938 widget->advance_waiting_command(get_name());
2939 }
2940 });
2941 timer->start();
2942
2943 }
2944
2945 void perform() override {
2946 }
2947
2948};
2949

2966 }

2995class WaitForRendersToFinishCommand : public GenericWaitCommand {
2996 int64_t start_ns = 0;
2997 int64_t start_us = 0;
2998 int poll_ticks = 0;
2999 bool initial_check_done = false;
3000 bool ready_reported = false;
3001public:
3002 static inline const std::string cname = "wait_for_renders_to_finish";
3003 static inline const std::string hname = "";
3004 WaitForRendersToFinishCommand(MainWidget* w) : GenericWaitCommand(cname, w) {
3005 start_ns = timing_diag_now_ns();
3006 start_us = start_ns / 1000;
3007 if (is_timing_diag_enabled()) {
3008 std::ostringstream ss;
3009 ss << "wait_for_renders_start t_ns=" << start_ns
3010 << " t_us=" << start_us;
3011 log_timing_diag(ss.str());
3012 }
3013 };
3014
3015 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) override {
3016 if (!initial_check_done) {
3017 initial_check_done = true;
3018 if (is_ready()) {
3019 finished = true;
3020 }
3021 }
3022 if (finished) {
3023 return {};
3024 }
3025 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Generic, "dummy" };
3026 }
3027
3028 void handle_generic_requirement() override {
3029 if (finished) return;
3030
3031 timer = new QTimer();
3032 timer->setInterval(100);
3033 timer_connection = QObject::connect(timer, &QTimer::timeout, [this]() {
3034 poll_ticks++;
3035 if (is_ready()) {
3036 widget->advance_waiting_command(get_name());
3037 }
3038 });
3039 timer->start();
3040 }
3041
3042 bool is_ready() override {
3043 if (ready_reported) return true;
3044 bool ready = widget->is_render_ready();
3045 if (ready) {
3046 ready_reported = true;
3047 if (is_timing_diag_enabled()) {
3048 int64_t reply_ns = timing_diag_now_ns();
3049 int64_t reply_us = reply_ns / 1000;
3050 std::ostringstream ss;
3051 ss << "ipc_reply t_ns=" << reply_ns
3052 << " t_us=" << reply_us
3053 << " poll_ticks=" << poll_ticks
3054 << " wait_ms=" << ((reply_ns - start_ns) / 1000000.0);
3055 log_timing_diag(ss.str());
3056 }
3057 }
3058 return ready;
3059 }
3060};

3151class MoveSmoothCommand : public Command {
3152 bool was_held = false;
3153 float velocity_multiplier = 1.0f;
3154 std::optional<FixedVelocityState> fixed_velocity_state_to_restore = {};
3155public:
3156 MoveSmoothCommand(std::string name, MainWidget* w, float velocity_mult=1.0f) : Command(name, w) {
3157 velocity_multiplier = velocity_mult;
3158 };
3159
3160 virtual bool is_down(){
3161 return false;
3162 }
3163
3164 virtual bool is_up(){
3165 return false;
3166 }
3167
3168 virtual bool is_left(){
3169 return false;
3170 }
3171
3172 virtual bool is_right(){
3173 return false;
3174 }
3175
3176 void perform() {
3177 if (widget->main_document_view->is_ruler_mode()) {
3178 if (is_down()) {
3179 widget->move_visual_mark_next();
3180 }
3181 if (is_up()) {
3182 widget->move_visual_mark_prev();
3183 }
3184 }
3185 else {
3186 widget->set_last_performed_command({});
3187 if (!fixed_velocity_state_to_restore.has_value()) {
3188 fixed_velocity_state_to_restore = widget->get_continuous_fixed_velocity_state();
3189 }
3190
3191 if (is_down() || is_up()){
3192 widget->handle_move_smooth_hold(is_down());
3193 widget->set_fixed_velocity(is_down() ? -SMOOTH_MOVE_MAX_VELOCITY * velocity_multiplier : SMOOTH_MOVE_MAX_VELOCITY * velocity_multiplier, 0);
3194 }
3195 else{
3196 widget->handle_move_smooth_hold(is_down());
3197 widget->set_fixed_velocity(0, is_left() ? -SMOOTH_MOVE_MAX_VELOCITY * velocity_multiplier : SMOOTH_MOVE_MAX_VELOCITY * velocity_multiplier);
3198 }
3199 }
3200 }
3201
3202 void perform_up() {
3203 if (fixed_velocity_state_to_restore.has_value()) {
3204 widget->restore_fixed_velocity_state(fixed_velocity_state_to_restore.value());
3205 fixed_velocity_state_to_restore = {};
3206 }
3207 else {
3208 widget->set_fixed_velocity(0, 0);
3209 }
3210 }
3211
3212 bool is_holdable() {
3213
3214 if (widget->main_document_view->is_ruler_mode()) {
3215 return false;
3216 }
3217 else {
3218 return true;
3219 }
3220 }
3221
3222 bool requires_document() {
3223 return true;
3224 }
3225
3226 void on_key_hold() {
3227 was_held = true;
3228 if (is_down() || is_up()){
3229 widget->handle_move_smooth_hold(is_down());
3230 }
3231 else{
3232 widget->handle_move_smooth_horizontal_hold(is_left());
3233 }
3234 widget->validate_render();
3235 }
3236};

3731class EditSelectedBookmarkCommand : public TextCommand {
3732public:
3733 static inline const std::string cname = "edit_selected_bookmark";
3734 static inline const std::string hname = "Edit selected bookmark";
3735 std::wstring initial_text;
3736 float initial_font_size;
3737 int index = -1;
3738
3739 EditSelectedBookmarkCommand(MainWidget* w) : TextCommand(cname, w) {};
3740
3741 void on_text_change(const QString& new_text) override {
3742 widget->doc()->get_bookmarks()[widget->selected_bookmark_index].description = new_text.toStdWString();
3743 }
3744
3745 void pre_perform() override {
3746
3747 if (widget->selected_bookmark_index > -1) {
3748 initial_text = widget->doc()->get_bookmarks()[widget->selected_bookmark_index].description;
3749 initial_font_size = widget->doc()->get_bookmarks()[widget->selected_bookmark_index].font_size;
3750 index = widget->selected_bookmark_index;
3751
3752 if (TOUCH_MODE) {
3753 if (widget->current_widget_stack.size() > 0) {
3754 TouchTextEdit* stack_top = dynamic_cast<TouchTextEdit*>(widget->current_widget_stack.back());
3755 if (stack_top) {
3756 stack_top->set_text(widget->doc()->get_bookmarks()[widget->selected_bookmark_index].description);
3757 }
3758 }
3759 }
3760 else {
3761 widget->text_command_line_edit->setText(
3762 QString::fromStdWString(widget->doc()->get_bookmarks()[widget->selected_bookmark_index].description)
3763 );
3764 }
3765 }
3766 }
3767
3768 void on_cancel() override {
3769 if (index > -1) {
3770 widget->doc()->get_bookmarks()[index].description = initial_text;
3771 widget->doc()->get_bookmarks()[index].font_size = initial_font_size;
3772 }
3773 TextCommand::on_cancel();
3774 }
3775
3776 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) override {
3777 if (widget->selected_bookmark_index == -1) return {};
3778 return TextCommand::next_requirement(widget);
3779 }
3780
3781 void perform() override {
3782 if (widget->selected_bookmark_index != -1) {

3853class GenericVisibleSelectCommand : public Command {
3854protected:
3855 std::vector<int> visible_item_indices;
3856 std::string tag;
3857 int n_required_tags = 0;
3858 bool already_pre_performed = false;
3859
3860public:
3861 GenericVisibleSelectCommand(std::string name, MainWidget* w) : Command(name, w) {};
3862
3863 virtual std::vector<int> get_visible_item_indices() = 0;
3864 virtual int get_selected_item_index() = 0;
3865 virtual void handle_indices_pre_perform() = 0;
3866
3867 void pre_perform() override {
3868 if (!already_pre_performed) {
3869 if (get_selected_item_index() == -1) {
3870 visible_item_indices = get_visible_item_indices();
3871 n_required_tags = get_num_tag_digits(visible_item_indices.size());
3872
3873 handle_indices_pre_perform();
3874 widget->invalidate_render();
3875 //widget->handle_highlight_tags_pre_perform(visible_item_indices);
3876 }
3877 already_pre_performed = true;
3878 }
3879 }
3880
3881 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) override {
3882 // since pre_perform must be executed in order to determine the requirements, we manually run it here
3883 pre_perform();
3884
3885 if (tag.size() < n_required_tags) {
3886 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Symbol, "tag" };
3887 }
3888 else {
3889 return {};
3890 }
3891 }
3892
3893
3894 virtual void set_symbol_requirement(char value) override {
3895 tag.push_back(value);
3896 }
3897
3898 virtual void perform_with_selected_index(std::optional<int> index) = 0;
3899
3900 void perform() override {
3901 bool should_clear_labels = false;
3902 if (tag.size() > 0) {
3903 int index = get_index_from_tag(tag);
3904 perform_with_selected_index(index);
3905 //if (index < visible_item_indices.size()) {
3906 // widget->set_selected_highlight_index(visible_highlight_indices[index]);
3907 //}
3908 should_clear_labels = true;
3909 }
3910 else {
3911 perform_with_selected_index({});
3912 }
3913
3914 if (should_clear_labels) {
3915 widget->clear_keyboard_select_highlights();
3916 }
3917 }
3918};

3953class GenericVisibleAnnotationCommand : public GenericVisibleSelectCommand {
3954
3955 std::vector<SioyekVisibleObjectIndex> visible_objects;
3956
3957public:
3958 GenericVisibleAnnotationCommand(std::string name, MainWidget* w) : GenericVisibleSelectCommand(name, w) {};
3959
3960 int get_selected_item_index() override{
3961 if (widget->selected_bookmark_index != -1) {
3962 return widget->selected_bookmark_index;
3963 }
3964 return widget->selected_highlight_index;
3965 }
3966
3967 std::vector<int> get_visible_item_indices() override {
3968 visible_objects.clear();
3969
3970 std::vector<int> visible_object_indices;
3971 std::vector<int> visible_bookmark_indices = widget->main_document_view->get_visible_bookmark_indices();
3972 std::vector<int> visible_highlight_indices = widget->main_document_view->get_visible_highlight_indices();
3973
3974 for (const auto& index : visible_bookmark_indices) {
3975 visible_objects.push_back({ SioyekVisibleObjectType::Bookmark, index });
3976 visible_object_indices.push_back(visible_object_indices.size());
3977 }
3978 for (const auto& index : visible_highlight_indices) {
3979 visible_objects.push_back({ SioyekVisibleObjectType::Highlight, index });
3980 visible_object_indices.push_back(visible_object_indices.size());
3981 }
3982
3983 return visible_object_indices;
3984 }
3985
3986
3987 void handle_indices_pre_perform() override {
3988 widget->handle_visible_objects_tags_pre_perform(visible_objects);
3989 }
3990
3991 virtual void perform_with_visible_object_selected() = 0;
3992
3993 void perform_with_selected_index(std::optional<int> index) override {
3994 if (index) {
3995 if (index < visible_objects.size()) {
3996 if (visible_objects[index.value()].type == SioyekVisibleObjectType::Highlight) {
3997 widget->set_selected_highlight_index(visible_objects[index.value()].index);
3998 widget->set_selected_bookmark_index(-1);
3999 }
4000 else if (visible_objects[index.value()].type == SioyekVisibleObjectType::Bookmark) {
4001 widget->set_selected_bookmark_index(visible_objects[index.value()].index);
4002 widget->set_selected_highlight_index(-1);
4003 }
4004 }
4005 }
4006
4007 perform_with_visible_object_selected();
4008 }
4009
4010};

4263class CopyCurrentChapterTextCommand : public Command {

4266 static inline const std::string hname = "Copy current chapter's text";
4267 CopyCurrentChapterTextCommand(MainWidget* w) : Command(cname, w) {};
4268 void perform() {
4269 auto chapter_page_range = widget->main_document_view->get_current_page_range();
4270 if (chapter_page_range) {
4271 auto [begin_page, end_page] = chapter_page_range.value();
4272 auto page_indices = widget->doc()->get_super_fast_search_page_indices();
4273 std::wstring& doc_text = widget->doc()->get_super_fast_search_index();
4274 if (begin_page >= 0 && begin_page < page_indices.size() && end_page >= 0 && end_page < page_indices.size()) {
4275 int begin_index = page_indices[begin_page];
4276 int end_index = end_page < page_indices.size() - 1 ? page_indices[end_page + 1] : doc_text.size();
4277
4278 copy_to_clipboard(doc_text.substr(begin_index, end_index - begin_index));
4279
4280 }
4281
4282 }
4283
4284 }
4285

4665
4666std::unique_ptr<MenuItems> parse_menu_string(MainWidget* widget, QString name, QString menu_string) {
4667 ParseState parser;
4668 parser.index = 0;
4669 parser.str = menu_string;
4670 std::unique_ptr<MenuItems> res = std::make_unique<MenuItems>();
4671 res->name = name.toStdWString();
4672 while (true) {
4673 std::vector<CommandInvocation> invocations = parser.parse_next_macro_command();
4674
4675 if (invocations.size() == 1 && invocations[0].command_name == "show_custom_context_menu") {
4676
4677 if (invocations[0].command_args.size() == 2) {
4678 res->items.push_back(parse_menu_string(widget, invocations[0].command_args[0], invocations[0].command_args[1]));
4679 }
4680 }
4681 else {
4682 res->items.push_back(std::make_unique<MacroCommand>(widget, widget->command_manager, "", invocations));
4683 }
4684 if (parser.eof()) break;
4685
4686 if (parser.cc() == '|') {
4687 parser.index++;
4688 }
4689 }
4690 return res;
4691}
4692
4693class ShowCustomContextMenuCommand : public Command {

4695 static inline const std::string cname = "show_custom_context_menu";

4697 ShowCustomContextMenuCommand(MainWidget* w) : Command(cname, w) {};
4698
4699 std::optional<std::wstring> menu_name = {};
4700 std::optional<std::wstring> commands = {};
4701
4702 virtual std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
4703 if (!menu_name.has_value()) {
4704 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Text, "Menu Name"};
4705 }
4706 if (!commands.has_value()) {
4707 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Text, "Commands"};
4708 }
4709 return {};
4710 }
4711
4712 virtual void set_text_requirement(std::wstring value) {
4713 if (!menu_name.has_value()) {
4714 menu_name = value;
4715 return;
4716 }
4717 if (!commands.has_value()) {
4718 commands = value;
4719 return;
4720 }
4721 }
4722
4723
4724 void perform() {
4725
4726 std::unique_ptr<MenuItems> menu = parse_menu_string(widget, QString::fromStdWString(menu_name.value()), QString::fromStdWString(commands.value()));
4727 widget->show_recursive_context_menu(std::move(menu));
4728 }

4730 bool requires_document() { return false; }

4909class OpenLinkCommand : public Command {
4910public:
4911 static inline const std::string cname = "open_link";
4912 static inline const std::string hname = "Go to PDF links using keyboard";
4913 OpenLinkCommand(MainWidget* w) : Command(cname, w) {};
4914protected:
4915 std::optional<std::wstring> text = {};
4916 bool already_pre_performed = false;
4917public:
4918
4919 virtual std::string text_requirement_name() {
4920 return "Label";
4921 }
4922
4923 bool is_done() {
4924 if ((!ALPHABETIC_LINK_TAGS && text.has_value())) return true;
4925 if (ALPHABETIC_LINK_TAGS && text.has_value() && (text.value().size() == get_num_tag_digits(widget->num_visible_links()))) return true;
4926 return false;
4927 }
4928
4929 virtual std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
4930 bool done = is_done();
4931
4932 if (done) {
4933 return {};
4934 }
4935 else {
4936 if (ALPHABETIC_LINK_TAGS) {
4937 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Symbol, "Label" };
4938 }
4939 else if ((widget->num_visible_links() < 10) && (!ALPHABETIC_LINK_TAGS)) {
4940 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Symbol, "Label" };
4941 }
4942 else {
4943 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Text, text_requirement_name() };
4944 }
4945 }
4946 }
4947
4948 virtual void perform() {
4949 widget->handle_open_link(text.value());
4950 }
4951
4952 void pre_perform() {
4953 if (already_pre_performed) return;
4954
4955 widget->clear_tag_prefix();
4956 widget->set_highlight_links(true, true);
4957 widget->invalidate_render();
4958 already_pre_performed = true;
4959 }
4960
4961 virtual void set_text_requirement(std::wstring value) {
4962 this->text = value;
4963 }
4964
4965 virtual void set_symbol_requirement(char value) {
4966 if (text.has_value()) {
4967 text.value().push_back(value);
4968 }
4969 else {
4970 std::wstring val;
4971 val.push_back(value);
4972 this->text = val;
4973 }
4974
4975 if (!is_done()) {
4976 widget->set_tag_prefix(text.value());
4977 }
4978 }
4979};

4998bool KeyboardSelectPointCommand::is_done() {
4999 if (!text.has_value()) return false;

5009std::optional<Requirement> KeyboardSelectPointCommand::next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
5010 bool done = is_done();
5011
5012 if (done) {
5013 return {};
5014 }
5015 else {
5016 if (requires_rect) {
5017 if (text.has_value() && text.value().size() >= 2) {
5018 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Symbol, "bottom right location" };
5019 }
5020 else {
5021 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Symbol, "top left location" };
5022 }
5023 }
5024 else {
5025 return Requirement{ RequirementType::Symbol, "point location" };
5026 }
5027 }

5030void KeyboardSelectPointCommand::perform() {
5031
5032 widget->clear_tag_prefix();
5033 widget->set_highlighted_tags({});
5034 result = text.value();
5035
5036 if (requires_rect) {
5037
5038 std::string tag1 = utf8_encode(result.value().substr(0, 2));
5039 std::string tag2 = utf8_encode(result.value().substr(2, 2));
5040 int index1 = get_index_from_tag(tag1);
5041 int index2 = get_index_from_tag(tag2);
5042 AbsoluteDocumentPos pos1 = widget->get_index_document_pos(index1).to_absolute(widget->doc());
5043 AbsoluteDocumentPos pos2 = widget->get_index_document_pos(index2).to_absolute(widget->doc());
5044 AbsoluteRect rect(pos1, pos2);
5045 origin->set_rect_requirement(rect);
5046 widget->set_rect_select_mode(false);
5047 //origin->set_point_requirement(abspos);
5048 }
5049 else {
5050
5051 int index = get_index_from_tag(utf8_encode(result.value()));
5052 AbsoluteDocumentPos abspos = widget->get_index_document_pos(index).to_absolute(widget->doc());
5053 origin->set_point_requirement(abspos);
5054 }
5055
5056 widget->clear_keyboard_select_highlights();
5057 widget->advance_command(std::move(origin));
5058}
5059
5060void KeyboardSelectPointCommand::pre_perform() {
5061 if (already_pre_performed) return;
5062
5063 widget->clear_tag_prefix();
5064 widget->highlight_window_points();
5065 widget->invalidate_render();
5066 already_pre_performed = true;
5067}

5074void KeyboardSelectPointCommand::set_symbol_requirement(char value) {
5075 if (text.has_value()) {
5076 text.value().push_back(value);
5077 }
5078 else {
5079 std::wstring val;
5080 val.push_back(value);
5081 this->text = val;
5082 }
5083
5084 if (!is_done()) {
5085 if (requires_rect && (text.value().size() >= 2)) {
5086 widget->set_tag_prefix(text.value().substr(2));
5087 }
5088 else {
5089 widget->set_tag_prefix(text.value());
5090 }
5091 }
5092 // update selected tags
5093 if (text.has_value()) {
5094 if (text->size() >= 2) {
5095 std::string tag = utf8_encode(text.value().substr(0, 2));
5096 widget->set_highlighted_tags({ tag });
5097 }
5098 }
5099}

5882class SetWindowRectCommand : public TextCommand {
5883public:
5884 static inline const std::string cname = "set_window_rect";
5885 static inline const std::string hname = "Move and resize the window to the given coordinates (in pixels).";
5886 SetWindowRectCommand(MainWidget* w) : TextCommand(cname, w) {};
5887
5888 void perform() {
5889 if (!text.has_value()) return;
5890
5891 QStringList parts = QString::fromStdWString(text.value()).split(' ');
5892 if (parts.size() < 4) {
5893 show_error_message(L"Invalid format. Expected: x y width height");
5894 return;
5895 }
5896
5897 bool ok1, ok2, ok3, ok4;
5898 int x0 = parts[0].toInt(&ok1);
5899 int y0 = parts[1].toInt(&ok2);
5900 int w = parts[2].toInt(&ok3);
5901 int h = parts[3].toInt(&ok4);
5902
5903 if (!ok1 || !ok2 || !ok3 || !ok4) {
5904 show_error_message(L"Invalid numbers in input");
5905 return;
5906 }
5907
5908 if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) {
5909 show_error_message(L"Width and height must be positive");
5910 return;
5911 }
5912
5913 widget->resize(w, h);
5914 widget->move(x0, y0);
5915 }
5916
5917};

6176class SelectRectCommand : public Command {
6177public:
6178 static inline const std::string cname = "select_rect";
6179 static inline const std::string hname = "Select a rectangle.";
6180 SelectRectCommand (MainWidget* w) : Command(cname, w) {};
6181 std::optional<AbsoluteRect> absrect = {};
6182
6183 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
6184
6185 if (!absrect.has_value()) {
6186 Requirement req = { RequirementType::Rect, "Command Rect" };
6187 return req;
6188 }
6189 return {};
6190 }
6191
6192 void set_rect_requirement(AbsoluteRect rect) {
6193 absrect = rect;
6194 }
6195
6196 void perform() {
6197 QJsonDocument doc;
6198 QJsonObject rect_json;
6199 rect_json["x0"] = absrect->x0;
6200 rect_json["y0"] = absrect->y0;
6201 rect_json["x1"] = absrect->x1;
6202 rect_json["y1"] = absrect->y1;
6203 doc.setObject(rect_json);
6204 result = utf8_decode(doc.toJson().toStdString());
6205 widget->clear_selected_rect();
6206 widget->set_rect_select_mode(false);
6207 }
6208
6209};

6764class CustomCommand : public Command {
6765
6766 std::wstring raw_command;
6767 std::string name;

6770 std::optional<std::wstring> command_text;
6771
6772public:
6773
6774 CustomCommand(MainWidget* widget_, std::string name_, std::wstring command_) : Command(name_, widget_) {
6775 raw_command = command_;
6776 name = name_;
6777 }
6778
6779 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
6780 if (command_requires_rect(raw_command) && (!command_rect.has_value())) {
6781 Requirement req = { RequirementType::Rect, "Command Rect" };
6782 return req;
6783 }
6784 if (command_requires_text(raw_command) && (!command_text.has_value())) {
6785 Requirement req = { RequirementType::Text, "Command Text" };
6786 return req;
6787 }
6788 return {};
6789 }
6790
6791 void set_rect_requirement(AbsoluteRect rect) {
6792 command_rect = rect;
6793 }
6794
6795 void set_point_requirement(AbsoluteDocumentPos point) {
6796 command_point = point;
6797 }
6798
6799 void set_text_requirement(std::wstring txt) {
6800 command_text = txt;
6801 }
6802
6803 void perform() {
6804 widget->execute_command(raw_command, command_text.value_or(L""));
6805 }
6806
6807 std::string get_name() {
6808 return name;
6809 }
6810
6811

6865class ConfigCommand : public Command {
6866 std::string config_name;
6867 std::optional<std::wstring> text = {};
6868 ConfigManager* config_manager;
6869 bool save_after_set = false;
6870public:
6871 ConfigCommand(
6872 MainWidget* widget_,
6873 std::string config_name_,
6874 ConfigManager* config_manager_,
6875 bool save_after_set_=false) :
6876 Command((save_after_set_ ? "setsaveconfig_" : "setconfig_") + config_name_, widget_), config_manager(config_manager_) {
6877
6878 save_after_set = save_after_set_;
6879 config_name = config_name_;
6880 }
6881
6882 void set_text_requirement(std::wstring value) {
6883 text = value;
6884 }
6885
6886 void set_file_requirement(std::wstring value) {
6887 text = value;
6888 }
6889
6890 std::wstring get_text_default_value() {
6891 Config* config = config_manager->get_mut_config_with_name(utf8_decode(config_name));
6892 std::wstringstream config_stream;
6893 config->serialize(config->value, config_stream);
6894 std::wstring default_value = config_stream.str();
6895
6896 return default_value;
6897 }
6898
6899 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
6900 if (TOUCH_MODE) {
6901 Config* config = config_manager->get_mut_config_with_name(utf8_decode(config_name));
6902 if ((!text.has_value()) && config->config_type == ConfigType::String) {
6903 Requirement res;
6904 res.type = RequirementType::Text;
6905 res.name = "Config Value";
6906 return res;
6907 }
6908 else if ((!text.has_value()) && config->config_type == ConfigType::FilePath) {
6909 Requirement res;
6910 res.type = RequirementType::File;
6911 res.name = "Config Value";
6912 return res;
6913 }
6914 else if ((!text.has_value()) && config->config_type == ConfigType::FolderPath) {
6915 Requirement res;
6916 res.type = RequirementType::Folder;
6917 res.name = "Config Value";
6918 return res;
6919 }
6920 return {};
6921 }
6922 else {
6923 if (text.has_value()) {
6924 return {};
6925 }
6926 else {
6927
6928 Requirement res;
6929 res.type = RequirementType::Text;
6930 res.name = "Config Value";
6931 return res;
6932 }
6933 }
6934 }
6935
6936 void perform() {
6937
6938 if (TOUCH_MODE) {
6939 Config* config = widget->config_manager->get_mut_config_with_name(utf8_decode(config_name));
6940
6941
6942 if (config->config_type == ConfigType::String || config->config_type == ConfigType::FilePath || config->config_type == ConfigType::FolderPath) {
6943 if (widget->config_manager->deserialize_config(config_name, text.value())) {
6944 widget->on_config_changed(config_name);
6945 }
6946 }
6947 if (config->config_type == ConfigType::Macro) {
6948 widget->push_current_widget(new MacroConfigUI(config_name, widget, (std::wstring*)config->value, *(std::wstring*)config->value));
6949 widget->show_current_widget();
6950 }
6951 if (config->config_type == ConfigType::Color3) {
6952 widget->push_current_widget(new Color3ConfigUI(config_name, widget, (float*)config->value));
6953 widget->show_current_widget();
6954 }
6955
6956 if (config->config_type == ConfigType::Color4) {
6957 widget->push_current_widget(new Color4ConfigUI(config_name, widget, (float*)config->value));
6958 widget->show_current_widget();
6959 }
6960 if (config->config_type == ConfigType::Bool) {
6961 widget->push_current_widget(new BoolConfigUI(config_name, widget, (bool*)config->value, QString::fromStdWString(config->name)));
6962 widget->show_current_widget();
6963 }
6964 if (config->config_type == ConfigType::EnableRectangle) {
6965 widget->push_current_widget(new RectangleConfigUI(config_name, widget, (UIRect*)config->value));
6966 widget->show_current_widget();
6967 }
6968 if (config->config_type == ConfigType::Float) {
6969 FloatExtras extras = std::get<FloatExtras>(config->extras);
6970 widget->push_current_widget(new FloatConfigUI(config_name, widget, (float*)config->value, extras.min_val, extras.max_val));
6971 widget->show_current_widget();
6972
6973 }
6974 if (config->config_type == ConfigType::Int) {
6975 IntExtras extras = std::get<IntExtras>(config->extras);
6976 widget->push_current_widget(new IntConfigUI(config_name, widget, (int*)config->value, extras.min_val, extras.max_val));
6977 widget->show_current_widget();
6978 }
6979
6980 // config->serialize
6981 }
6982 else {
6983
6984
6985 if (text.value().size() > 1) {
6986 if (text.value().substr(0, 2) == L"+=" || text.value().substr(0, 2) == L"-=") {
6987 std::wstring config_name_encoded = utf8_decode(config_name);
6988 Config* config_mut = widget->config_manager->get_mut_config_with_name(config_name_encoded);
6989 ConfigType config_type = config_mut->config_type;
6990
6991 if (config_type == ConfigType::Int) {
6992 int mult = text.value()[0] == '+' ? 1 : -1;
6993 int* config_ptr = (int*)config_mut->value;
6994 int prev_value = *config_ptr;
6995 int new_value = QString::fromStdWString(text.value()).right(text.value().size() - 2).toInt();
6996 *config_ptr += mult * new_value;
6997 widget->on_config_changed(config_name, save_after_set);
6998 return;
6999 }
7000
7001 if (config_type == ConfigType::Float) {
7002 float mult = text.value()[0] == '+' ? 1 : -1;
7003 float* config_ptr = (float*)config_mut->value;
7004 float prev_value = *config_ptr;
7005 float new_value = QString::fromStdWString(text.value()).right(text.value().size() - 2).toFloat();
7006 *config_ptr += mult * new_value;
7007 widget->on_config_changed(config_name, save_after_set);
7008 return;
7009 }
7010 }
7011 }
7012 if (widget->config_manager->deserialize_config(config_name, text.value())) {
7013 widget->on_config_changed(config_name, save_after_set);
7014 }
7015 }
7016 }
7017
7018 bool requires_document() { return false; }
7019};

7193class HoldableCommand : public Command {
7194 std::unique_ptr<Command> down_command = {};
7195 std::unique_ptr<Command> up_command = {};
7196 std::unique_ptr<Command> hold_command = {};
7197 std::string name;
7198 CommandManager* command_manager;
7199
7200public:
7201 HoldableCommand(MainWidget* widget_, CommandManager* manager, std::string name_, std::wstring commands_) : Command(name_, widget_) {
7202 command_manager = manager;
7203 name = name_;
7204 QString str = QString::fromStdWString(commands_);
7205 QStringList parts = str.split('|');
7206 if (parts.size() == 2) {
7207 down_command = std::make_unique<MacroCommand>(widget, manager, name_ + "{down}", parts[0].toStdWString());
7208 up_command = std::make_unique<MacroCommand>(widget, manager, name_ + "{up}", parts[1].toStdWString());
7209 }
7210 else {
7211 down_command = std::make_unique<MacroCommand>(widget, manager, name_ + "{down}", parts[0].toStdWString());
7212 hold_command = std::make_unique<MacroCommand>(widget, manager, name_ + "{hold}", parts[1].toStdWString());
7213 up_command = std::make_unique<MacroCommand>(widget, manager, name_ + "{up}", parts[2].toStdWString());
7214 }
7215 }
7216
7217 std::optional<Requirement> next_requirement(MainWidget* widget) {
7218 // holdable commands can't have requirements
7219 return {};
7220 }
7221
7222 bool requires_document() {
7223 return true;
7224 }
7225
7226 void perform() {
7227 down_command->run();
7228 }
7229
7230 void perform_up() {
7231 up_command->run();
7232 }
7233
7234 void on_key_hold() {
7235 if (hold_command) {
7236 hold_command->run();
7237 }
7238 }
7239
7240
7241 bool is_holdable() {
7242 return true;
7243 }
7244
7245
7246};

7546 for (auto [command_name_, command_value] : ADDITIONAL_COMMANDS) {

7550 command_required_prefixes[QString::fromStdString(command_name)] = "_";
7551 }
7552
7553
7554 for (auto [command_name_, js_command_info] : ADDITIONAL_JAVASCRIPT_COMMANDS) {
7555 handle_new_javascript_command(command_name_, js_command_info, false);
7556 command_required_prefixes[QString::fromStdWString(command_name_)] = "_";
7557 }
7558
7559 for (auto [command_name_, js_command_info] : ADDITIONAL_ASYNC_JAVASCRIPT_COMMANDS) {
7560 handle_new_javascript_command(command_name_, js_command_info, true);
7561 command_required_prefixes[QString::fromStdWString(command_name_)] = "_";
7562 }
7563
7564 for (auto [command_name_, macro_value] : ADDITIONAL_MACROS) {
7565 std::string command_name = utf8_encode(command_name_);

7568 command_required_prefixes[QString::fromStdString(command_name)] = "_";
7569 }
7570
7571 std::vector<Config> configs = config_manager->get_configs();
7572
7573 for (auto conf : configs) {
7574
7575 std::string confname = utf8_encode(conf.name);
7576 std::string config_set_command_name = "setconfig_" + confname;
7577 new_commands[config_set_command_name] = [confname, config_manager](MainWidget* w) {return std::make_unique<ConfigCommand>(w, confname, config_manager); };

7580 std::string config_setsave_command_name = "setsaveconfig_" + confname;
7581 new_commands[config_setsave_command_name] = [confname, config_manager](MainWidget* w) {return std::make_unique<ConfigCommand>(w, confname, config_manager, true); };
7582 command_required_prefixes[QString::fromStdString(config_setsave_command_name)] = "setsaveconfig_";
7583
7584 std::string config_save_command_name = "saveconfig_" + confname;
7585 new_commands[config_save_command_name] = [confname, config_manager](MainWidget* w) {return std::make_unique<SaveConfigCommand>(w, confname); };
7586 command_required_prefixes[QString::fromStdString(config_save_command_name)] = "saveconfig_";
7587
7588 std::string config_delete_command_name = "deleteconfig_" + confname;
7589 new_commands[config_delete_command_name] = [confname, config_manager](MainWidget* w) {return std::make_unique<DeleteConfigCommand>(w, confname); };
7590 command_required_prefixes[QString::fromStdString(config_delete_command_name)] = "deleteconfig_";
7591
7592 if (conf.config_type == ConfigType::Bool) {
7593 std::string config_toggle_command_name = "toggleconfig_" + confname;
7594 new_commands[config_toggle_command_name] = [confname, config_manager](MainWidget* w) {return std::make_unique<ToggleConfigCommand>(w, confname); };
7595 command_required_prefixes[QString::fromStdString(config_toggle_command_name)] = "toggleconfig_";
7596 }
7597
7598 }
7599
7600 QDateTime current_time = QDateTime::currentDateTime();
7601 QDateTime older_time = current_time.addSecs(-1);
7602 for (auto [command_name, _] : new_commands) {
7603 if (command_name.size() > 0 && command_name[0] == '_') {
7604 command_last_uses[command_name] = older_time;
7605 }
7606 else {
7607 command_last_uses[command_name] = current_time;
7608 }
7609 }
7610
7611}

7617void CommandManager::handle_new_javascript_command(std::wstring command_name_, JsCommandInfo info, bool is_async) {
7618 std::string command_name = utf8_encode(command_name_);
7619 auto [command_parent_file_path, command_file_path, entry_point] = info;
7620
7621 QDir parent_dir = QFileInfo(QString::fromStdWString(command_parent_file_path)).dir();
7622 QFileInfo javascript_file_info(QString::fromStdWString(command_file_path));
7623 QString absolute_file_path;
7624
7625 if (javascript_file_info.isRelative()){
7626 absolute_file_path = parent_dir.absoluteFilePath(javascript_file_info.filePath());
7627 }
7628 else{
7629 absolute_file_path = javascript_file_info.absoluteFilePath();
7630 }
7631 QFile code_file(absolute_file_path);
7632 if (code_file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly)) {
7633 QTextStream in(&code_file);
7634 QString code = in.readAll();
7635 new_commands[command_name] = [command_name, code, entry_point=entry_point, is_async, this](MainWidget* w) {
7636 return std::make_unique<JavascriptCommand>(command_name, code.toStdWString(), entry_point, is_async, w);
7637 };
7638 }
7639 else {
7640 std::wcout << L"Could not open file " << absolute_file_path.toStdWString() << L"\n";
7641 }
7642}

7652QStringList CommandManager::get_all_command_names() {
7653 std::vector<std::pair<QDateTime, QString>> pairs;
7654 QStringList res;
7655
7656 if (SHOW_MOST_RECENT_COMMANDS_FIRST) {
7657 for (const auto& com : new_commands) {
7658 pairs.push_back(std::make_pair(command_last_uses[com.first], QString::fromStdString(com.first)));
7659 }
7660
7661 std::sort(pairs.begin(), pairs.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
7662 return a.first > b.first;
7663 });
7664
7665 for (auto [_, com] : pairs) {
7666 res.push_back(com);
7667 }
7668 }
7669 else {
7670 for (const auto& com : new_commands) {
7671 res.push_back(QString::fromStdString(com.first));
7672 }
7673 }
7674
7675
7676 return res;
7677}

7679void print_tree_node(InputParseTreeNode node) {
7680 if (node.requires_text) {
7681 std::wcerr << "text node" << std::endl;
7682 return;
7683 }
7684 if (node.requires_symbol) {
7685 std::wcerr << "symbol node" << std::endl;
7686 return;
7687 }
7688
7689 if (node.control_modifier) {
7690 std::wcerr << "Ctrl+";
7691 }
7692
7693 if (node.command_modifier) {
7694 std::wcerr << "Cmd+";
7695 }
7696
7697 if (node.shift_modifier) {
7698 std::wcerr << "Shift+";
7699 }
7700
7701 if (node.alt_modifier) {
7702 std::wcerr << "Alt+";
7703 }
7704 std::wcerr << node.command << std::endl;
7705}
7706
7707InputParseTreeNode parse_token(std::wstring token) {
7708 InputParseTreeNode res;
7709
7710 if (token == L"sym") {
7711 res.requires_symbol = true;
7712 return res;
7713 }
7714 if (token == L"txt") {
7715 res.requires_text = true;
7716 return res;
7717 }
7718
7719 std::vector<std::wstring> subcommands;
7720 split_key_string(token, L"-", subcommands);
7721
7722 for (size_t i = 0; i < subcommands.size() - 1; i++) {
7723 if (subcommands[i] == L"C") {
7724 res.control_modifier = true;
7725 }
7726
7727 if (subcommands[i] == L"D") {
7728 res.command_modifier = true;
7729 }
7730
7731 if (subcommands[i] == L"S") {
7732 res.shift_modifier = true;
7733 }
7734
7735 if (subcommands[i] == L"A") {
7736 res.alt_modifier = true;
7737 }
7738 }
7739
7740 std::wstring command_string = subcommands[subcommands.size() - 1];
7741 if (command_string.size() == 1) {
7742 res.command = subcommands[subcommands.size() - 1][0];
7743 }
7744 else {
7745
7746 if (int f_key = get_f_key(command_string)) {
7747 res.command = Qt::Key::Key_F1 - 1 + f_key;
7748 }
7749 else {
7750
7751 std::map<std::wstring, Qt::Key> keymap_temp = {
7752 {L"up", Qt::Key::Key_Up},
7753 {L"down", Qt::Key::Key_Down},
7754 {L"left", Qt::Key::Key_Left},
7755 {L"right", Qt::Key::Key_Right},
7756 {L"backspace", Qt::Key::Key_Backspace},
7757 {L"space", Qt::Key::Key_Space},
7758 {L"pageup", Qt::Key::Key_PageUp},
7759 {L"pagedown", Qt::Key::Key_PageDown},
7760 {L"home", Qt::Key::Key_Home},
7761 {L"end", Qt::Key::Key_End},
7762 {L"pagedown", Qt::Key::Key_End},
7763 {L"tab", Qt::Key::Key_Tab},
7764 {L"return", Qt::Key::Key_Return},
7765 };
7766 std::map<std::wstring, Qt::Key> keymap;
7767
7768 for (auto item : keymap_temp) {
7769 keymap[item.first] = item.second;
7770 keymap[L"<" + item.first + L">"] = item.second;
7771 }
7772
7773 res.command = keymap[command_string];
7774 }
7775
7776 }
7777
7778 return res;
7779}
7780void get_tokens(std::wstring line, std::vector<std::wstring>& tokens) {
7781 std::wstring stack;
7782
7783 int stack_depth = 0;
7784
7785 for (wchar_t c : line) {
7786 if (stack_depth && (c != '>') && (c != '<')) {
7787 stack.push_back(c);
7788 }
7789 else if (c == '>') {
7790 stack_depth--;
7791 if (stack_depth == 0) {
7792 tokens.push_back(stack);
7793 stack.clear();
7794 }
7795 else {
7796 stack.push_back(c);
7797 }
7798 }
7799 else if (c == '<') {
7800 if (stack_depth) {
7801 stack.push_back(c);
7802 }
7803 stack_depth++;
7804 }
7805 else {
7806 tokens.push_back(std::wstring(1, c));
7807 }
7808
7809 }
7810}
7811
7812bool is_command_incomplete_macro(const std::vector<std::string>& commands){
7813
7814 for (auto com : commands){
7815 if (com.find("[") == -1){
7816 return false;
7817 }
7818 if (com.find("[]") != -1){
7819 return false;
7820 }
7821 }
7822 return true;
7823}
7824
7825InputParseTreeNode* parse_lines(
7826 InputParseTreeNode* root,
7827 CommandManager* command_manager,
7828 const std::vector<std::wstring>& lines,
7829 const std::vector<std::wstring>& command_strings,
7830 const std::vector<std::wstring>& command_file_names,
7831 const std::vector<int>& command_line_numbers
7832) {
7833
7834 for (size_t j = 0; j < lines.size(); j++) {
7835 std::wstring line = lines[j];
7836
7837 // for example convert "<a-<space>> to ["a", "space"]
7838 std::vector<std::wstring> tokens;
7839 get_tokens(line, tokens);
7840
7841 InputParseTreeNode* parent_node = root;
7842
7843 for (size_t i = 0; i < tokens.size(); i++) {
7844 InputParseTreeNode node = parse_token(tokens[i]);
7845 if ((node.control_modifier || node.command_modifier || node.alt_modifier) && node.shift_modifier) {
7846 std::vector<int> special_texts = { '\b', '\u007F', '\t', ' ', '\r', '\n' };
7847 bool is_special = (std::find(special_texts.begin(), special_texts.end(), node.command) != special_texts.end()) || (node.command >= 128);
7848 if (!is_special) {
7849 LOG(
7850 std::wcerr << L"Warning: keybind: `" << line << "` defined in " << command_file_names[j] << L":" << command_line_numbers[j] << L" for " << command_strings[j] << L" is no longer valid. We now use something like this:\ncommand <C-O>\nInstead of:\ncommand <C-S-O>\n"
7851 );
7852 }
7853 }
7854
7855 bool existing_node = false;
7856 for (InputParseTreeNode* child : parent_node->children) {
7857 if (child->is_same(&node)) {
7858 parent_node = child;
7859 existing_node = true;
7860 break;
7861 }
7862 }
7863 if (!existing_node) {
7864 if ((tokens[i] != L"sym") && (tokens[i] != L"txt")) {
7865 if (parent_node->is_final) {
7866 LOG(std::wcerr
7867 << L"Warning: key defined in " << command_file_names[j]
7868 << L":" << command_line_numbers[j]
7869 << L" for " << command_strings[j]
7870 << L" is unreachable, shadowed by final key sequence defined in "
7871 << parent_node->defining_file_path
7872 << L":" << parent_node->defining_file_line << L"\n");
7873 }
7874 auto new_node = new InputParseTreeNode(node);
7875 new_node->defining_file_line = command_line_numbers[j];
7876 new_node->defining_file_path = command_file_names[j];
7877 parent_node->children.push_back(new_node);
7878 parent_node = parent_node->children[parent_node->children.size() - 1];
7879 }
7880 else {
7881 if (tokens[i] == L"sym") {
7882 parent_node->requires_symbol = true;
7883 parent_node->is_final = true;
7884 }
7885
7886 if (tokens[i] == L"txt") {
7887 parent_node->requires_text = true;
7888 parent_node->is_final = true;
7889 }
7890 }
7891 }
7892 else if (((size_t)i == (tokens.size() - 1)) &&
7893 (SHOULD_WARN_ABOUT_USER_KEY_OVERRIDE ||
7894 (command_file_names[j].compare(parent_node->defining_file_path)) == 0)) {
7895 if ((parent_node->name_.size() == 0) || parent_node->name_[0].compare(utf8_encode(command_strings[j])) != 0) {
7896 if (!is_command_string_modal(command_strings[j])) {
7897
7898 std::wcerr << L"Warning: key defined in " << parent_node->defining_file_path
7899 << L":" << parent_node->defining_file_line
7900 << L" overwritten by " << command_file_names[j]
7901 << L":" << command_line_numbers[j];
7902 if (parent_node->name_.size() > 0) {
7903 std::wcerr << L". Overriding command: " << line
7904 << L": replacing " << utf8_decode(parent_node->name_[0])
7905 << L" with " << command_strings[j];
7906 }
7907 std::wcerr << L"\n";
7908 }
7909 }
7910 }
7911 if ((size_t)i == (tokens.size() - 1)) {
7912 parent_node->is_final = true;
7913
7914 QString command_name_qstr = QString::fromStdWString(command_strings[j]);
7915 std::vector<std::string> command_names = parse_command_name(command_name_qstr);
7916 std::vector<std::string> previous_names = std::move(parent_node->name_);
7917 parent_node->name_ = {};
7918 parent_node->defining_file_line = command_line_numbers[j];
7919 parent_node->defining_file_path = command_file_names[j];
7920 for (size_t k = 0; k < command_names.size(); k++) {
7921 parent_node->name_.push_back(command_names[k]);
7922 }
7923 if (command_name_qstr.startsWith("{holdable}")) {
7924 if (command_name_qstr.indexOf("|") == -1) {
7925 qDebug() << "Error in " << command_file_names[j] << ":" << command_line_numbers[j] << ": holdable command " << command_name_qstr << " does not contain a | character";
7926 }
7927 else {
7928 std::wstring actual_command = command_name_qstr.mid(10).toStdWString();
7929 parent_node->generator = [command_manager, actual_command](MainWidget* w) {return std::make_unique<HoldableCommand>(
7930 w, command_manager, "", actual_command); };
7931 }
7932 }
7933 else if (command_names.size() == 1 && (command_names[0].find("[") == -1) && (command_names[0].find("(") == -1)) {
7934 if (command_manager->new_commands.find(command_names[0]) != command_manager->new_commands.end()) {
7935 parent_node->generator = command_manager->new_commands[command_names[0]];
7936 }
7937 else {
7938 std::wcerr << L"Warning: command " << utf8_decode(command_names[0]) << L" used in " << parent_node->defining_file_path
7939 << L":" << parent_node->defining_file_line << L" not found.\n";
7940 }
7941 }
7942 else {
7943 QStringList command_parts;
7944 for (int k = 0; k < command_names.size(); k++) {
7945 command_parts.append(QString::fromStdString(command_names[k]));
7946 }
7947
7948 // is the command incomplete and should be appended to previous command instead of replacing it?
7949 if (is_command_incomplete_macro(command_names)) {
7950 for (int k = 0; k < previous_names.size(); k++) {
7951 command_parts.append(QString::fromStdString(previous_names[k]));
7952 parent_node->name_.push_back(previous_names[k]);
7953 }
7954 }
7955
7956 std::wstring joined_command = command_parts.join(";").toStdWString();
7957 parent_node->generator = [joined_command, command_manager](MainWidget* w) {return std::make_unique<MacroCommand>(w, command_manager, "", joined_command); };
7958 }
7959 //if (command_names[j].size())
7960 }
7961 else {
7962 if (SHOULD_WARN_ABOUT_USER_KEY_OVERRIDE && parent_node->is_final && (parent_node->name_.size() > 0)) {
7963 std::wcerr << L"Warning: unmapping " << utf8_decode(parent_node->name_[0]) << L" because of " << command_strings[j] << L" which uses " << line << L"\n";
7964 }
7965 parent_node->is_final = false;
7966 }
7967
7968 }
7969 }
7970
7971 return root;
7972}
7973
7974InputParseTreeNode* parse_lines(
7975 CommandManager* command_manager,
7976 const std::vector<std::wstring>& lines,
7977 const std::vector<std::wstring>& command_names,
7978 const std::vector<std::wstring>& command_file_names,
7979 const std::vector<int>& command_line_numbers
7980) {
7981 // parse key configs into a trie where leaves are annotated with the name of the command
7982
7983 InputParseTreeNode* root = new InputParseTreeNode;
7984 root->is_root = true;
7985
7986 parse_lines(root, command_manager, lines, command_names, command_file_names, command_line_numbers);
7987
7988 return root;
7989
7990}

7992
7993void get_keys_file_lines(const Path& file_path,
7994 std::vector<std::wstring>& command_strings,
7995 std::vector<std::wstring>& command_keys,
7996 std::vector<std::wstring>& command_files,
7997 std::vector<int>& command_line_numbers) {
7998
7999 std::ifstream infile = std::ifstream(utf8_encode(file_path.get_path()));
8000
8001 int line_number = 0;
8002 std::wstring default_path_name = file_path.get_path();
8003 while (infile.good()) {
8004 line_number++;
8005 std::string line_;
8006 std::wstring line;
8007 std::getline(infile, line_);
8008 line = utf8_decode(line_);
8009
8010 if (line.size() == 0 || line[0] == '#') {
8011 continue;
8012 }
8013
8014 QString line_string = QString::fromStdWString(line).trimmed();
8015 int last_space_index = line_string.lastIndexOf(' ');
8016
8017 if (last_space_index >= 0){
8018 std::wstring command_name = line_string.left(last_space_index).trimmed().toStdWString();
8019 std::wstring command_key = line_string.right(line_string.size() - last_space_index - 1).trimmed().toStdWString();
8020
8021 command_strings.push_back(command_name);
8022 command_keys.push_back(command_key);
8023 command_files.push_back(default_path_name);
8024 command_line_numbers.push_back(line_number);
8025 }
8026 }
8027
8028 infile.close();
8029}
8030
8031InputParseTreeNode* parse_key_config_files(CommandManager* command_manager, const Path& default_path,
8032 const std::vector<Path>& user_paths) {
8033
8034 std::wifstream default_infile = open_wifstream(default_path.get_path());
8035
8036 std::vector<std::wstring> command_strings;
8037 std::vector<std::wstring> command_keys;
8038 std::vector<std::wstring> command_files;
8039 std::vector<int> command_line_numbers;
8040
8041 get_keys_file_lines(default_path, command_strings, command_keys, command_files, command_line_numbers);
8042 for (auto upath : user_paths) {
8043 get_keys_file_lines(upath, command_strings, command_keys, command_files, command_line_numbers);
8044 }
8045
8046 for (auto additional_keymap : ADDITIONAL_KEYMAPS) {
8047 QString keymap_string = QString::fromStdWString(additional_keymap.keymap_string);
8048 int last_space_index = keymap_string.lastIndexOf(' ');
8049 std::wstring command_name = keymap_string.left(last_space_index).toStdWString();
8050 std::wstring mapping = keymap_string.right(keymap_string.size() - last_space_index - 1).toStdWString();
8051 command_strings.push_back(command_name);
8052 command_keys.push_back(mapping);
8053 command_files.push_back(additional_keymap.file_name);
8054 command_line_numbers.push_back(additional_keymap.line_number);
8055 }
8056
8057 return parse_lines(command_manager, command_keys, command_strings, command_files, command_line_numbers);
8058}

8084std::unique_ptr<Command> InputHandler::get_menu_command(MainWidget* w, QKeyEvent* key_event, bool shift_pressed, bool control_pressed, bool command_pressed, bool alt_pressed) {
8085 // get the command for keyevent while we are in a menu. In menus we don't

8087 int key = get_event_key(key_event, &shift_pressed, &control_pressed, &command_pressed, &alt_pressed);

8095
8096 return {};

8099int InputHandler::get_event_key(QKeyEvent* key_event, bool* shift_pressed, bool* control_pressed, bool* command_pressed, bool* alt_pressed) {
8100 int key = 0;
8101 if (!USE_LEGACY_KEYBINDS) {
8102 std::vector<QString> special_texts = { "\b", "\u007F", "\t", " ", "\r", "\n" };
8103 if (((key_event->key() >= 'A') && (key_event->key() <= 'Z')) || ((key_event->text().size() > 0) &&
8104 (std::find(special_texts.begin(), special_texts.end(), key_event->text()) == special_texts.end()))) {
8105 if (!(*control_pressed) && !(*alt_pressed) && !(*command_pressed)) {
8106 std::wstring text = key_event->text().toStdWString();
8107 key = key_event->text().toStdWString()[0];
8108 }
8109 else {
8110 auto text = key_event->text();
8111 key = key_event->key();
8112
8113 if ((key >= 'A' && key <= 'Z') && (!*shift_pressed)) {
8114 if (!*shift_pressed) {
8115 key = key - 'A' + 'a';
8116 }
8117 }
8118 }
8119 // shift is already handled in the returned text
8120 *shift_pressed = false;
8121 }
8122 else {
8123 key = key_event->key();
8124
8125 if (key == Qt::Key::Key_Backtab) {
8126 key = Qt::Key::Key_Tab;
8127 }
8128 }
8129 }
8130 else {
8131 key = key_event->key();
8132 if (key >= 'A' && key <= 'Z') {
8133 key = key - 'A' + 'a';
8134 }
8135
8136 }
8137 return key;
8138}

8140std::unique_ptr<Command> InputHandler::handle_key(MainWidget* w, QKeyEvent* key_event, bool shift_pressed, bool control_pressed, bool command_pressed, bool alt_pressed, int* num_repeats) {
8141
8142 int key = get_event_key(key_event, &shift_pressed, &control_pressed, &command_pressed, &alt_pressed);
8143 if (current_node == root && is_digit(key)) {
8144 if (!(key == '0' && (number_stack.size() == 0)) && (!control_pressed) && (!shift_pressed) && (!alt_pressed) && (!command_pressed)) {
8145 number_stack.push_back('0' + key - Qt::Key::Key_0);
8146 return nullptr;
8147 }
8148 }
8149
8150 for (InputParseTreeNode* child : current_node->children) {
8151 //if (child->command == key && child->shift_modifier == shift_pressed && child->control_modifier == control_pressed){
8152 if (child->matches(key, shift_pressed, control_pressed, command_pressed, alt_pressed)) {
8153 if (child->is_final == true) {
8154 current_node = root;
8155 //cout << child->name << endl;
8156 *num_repeats = 0;
8157 if (number_stack.size() > 0) {
8158 *num_repeats = atoi(number_stack.c_str());
8159 number_stack.clear();
8160 }
8161
8162 //return command_manager.get_command_with_name(child->name);
8163 if (child->generator.has_value()) {
8164 return (child->generator.value())(w);
8165 }
8166 return nullptr;
8167 //for (size_t i = 0; i < child->name.size(); i++) {
8168 // res.push_back(command_manager->get_command_with_name(child->name[i]));
8169 //}
8170 //return res;
8171 }
8172 else {
8173 current_node = child;
8174 return nullptr;
8175 }
8176 }
8177 }
8178 std::wstring key_str;
8179 if (key >= 32 && key <= 126) {
8180 key_str = std::wstring(1, static_cast<wchar_t>(key));
8181 } else {
8182 QString seq = QKeySequence(static_cast<int>(key)).toString();
8183 if (!seq.isEmpty()) {
8184 key_str = seq.toStdWString();
8185 } else {
8186 std::wstringstream ss;
8187 ss << L"0x" << std::hex << key;
8188 key_str = ss.str();
8189 }
8190 }
8191 LOG(std::wcerr << L"Warning: invalid command (key:" << key_str << L"); resetting to root" << std::endl);
8192 number_stack.clear();
8193 current_node = root;
8194 return nullptr;
8195}

8252void InputHandler::get_commands_with_current_prefix_helper(InputParseTreeNode* node, std::vector<InputParseTreeNode*> prefix, std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>>& map) const {
8253 for (size_t i = 0; i < node->children.size(); i++) {
8254 prefix.push_back(node->children[i]);
8255 if (node->children[i]->is_final){
8256 std::string full_name;
8257 int index = 0;

8259 full_name += name;
8260 if (index < node->children[i]->name_.size() - 1){
8261 full_name += ";";
8262 }
8263 index++;
8264 }
8265 map[full_name].push_back(get_key_string_from_tree_node_sequence(prefix));
8266 }
8267 else {
8268 get_commands_with_current_prefix_helper(node->children[i], prefix, map);
8269 }
8270 prefix.pop_back();
8271 }

8290void InputHandler::add_command_key_mappings(InputParseTreeNode* thisroot,
8291 std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>>& map,
8292 std::vector<InputParseTreeNode*> prefix) const {
8293
8294 if (thisroot->is_final) {
8295 if (thisroot->name_.size() == 1) {
8296 map[thisroot->name_[0]].push_back(get_key_string_from_tree_node_sequence(prefix));
8297 }
8298 else if (thisroot->name_.size() > 1) {
8299 for (const auto& name : thisroot->name_) {
8300 map[name].push_back("{" + get_key_string_from_tree_node_sequence(prefix) + "}");
8301 }
8302 }
8303 }
8304 else {
8305 for (size_t i = 0; i < thisroot->children.size(); i++) {
8306 prefix.push_back(thisroot->children[i]);
8307 add_command_key_mappings(thisroot->children[i], map, prefix);
8308 prefix.pop_back();
8309 }
8310
8311 }
8312}

8314std::string InputHandler::get_key_name_from_key_code(int key_code) const {
8315 std::string result;
8316 std::map<int, std::string> keymap = {
8317 {Qt::Key::Key_Up, "up"},
8318 {Qt::Key::Key_Down, "down"},
8319 {Qt::Key::Key_Left, "left"},
8320 {Qt::Key::Key_Right, "right"},
8321 {Qt::Key::Key_Backspace, "backspace"},
8322 {Qt::Key::Key_Space, "space"},
8323 {Qt::Key::Key_PageUp, "pageup"},
8324 {Qt::Key::Key_PageDown, "pagedown"},
8325 {Qt::Key::Key_Home, "home"},
8326 {Qt::Key::Key_End, "end"},
8327 {Qt::Key::Key_Tab, "tab"},
8328 {Qt::Key::Key_Backtab, "tab"},
8329 };
8330
8331 //if (((key_code <= 'z') && (key_code >= 'a')) || ((key_code <= 'Z') && (key_code >= 'A'))) {
8332 if (key_code < 127) {
8333 result.push_back(key_code);
8334 return result;
8335 }
8336 else if (keymap.find(key_code) != keymap.end()) {
8337 return "<" + keymap[key_code] + ">";
8338 }
8339 else if ((key_code >= Qt::Key::Key_F1) && (key_code <= Qt::Key::Key_F35)) {
8340 int f_number = 1 + (key_code - Qt::Key::Key_F1);
8341 return "<f" + QString::number(f_number).toStdString() + ">";
8342 }
8343 else {
8344 return "UNK";
8345 }
8346}

8348std::string InputHandler::get_key_string_from_tree_node_sequence(const std::vector<InputParseTreeNode*> seq) const {
8349 std::string res;
8350 for (size_t i = 0; i < seq.size(); i++) {
8351 bool has_modifier = seq[i]->alt_modifier || seq[i]->shift_modifier || seq[i]->control_modifier || seq[i]->command_modifier;
8352 if (has_modifier) {
8353 res += "<";
8354 }
8355 std::string current_key_command_name = get_key_name_from_key_code(seq[i]->command);
8356
8357 if (seq[i]->alt_modifier) {
8358 res += "A-";
8359 }
8360 if (seq[i]->control_modifier) {
8361 res += "C-";
8362 }
8363 if (seq[i]->command_modifier) {
8364 res += "D-";
8365 }
8366 if (seq[i]->shift_modifier) {
8367 res += "S-";
8368 }
8369 res += current_key_command_name;
8370 if (has_modifier) {
8371 res += ">";
8372 }
8373 }
8374 return res;
8375}

8472void Command::on_result_computed() {
8473
8474 if (dynamic_cast<MacroCommand*>(this)) {
8475 return;
8476 }
8477 if (dynamic_cast<LazyCommand*>(this)) {
8478 return;
8479 }
8480 if (result_socket && result_socket->isOpen()){
8481 if (!result.has_value()) {
8482 result_socket->write("<NULL>");
8483 return;
8484 }
8485 std::string result_str = utf8_encode(result.value());
8486 if (result_str.size() > 0) {
8487 result_socket->write(result_str.c_str());
8488 }
8489 else {
8490 result_socket->write("<NULL>");
8491 }
8492 }
8493 if (is_done) {
8494 if (result) {
8495 *result_holder = result.value();
8496 }
8497 else {
8498 *result_holder = L"";
8499 }
8500
8501 *is_done = true;
8502 }
8503
8504}
